rules.title: Missing Entity ID In Registry
rules.description: Referenced entity/concept ID absent from registry.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if ID used but not registered.

rules.title: Duplicate Entity ID In Registry
rules.description: Same entity/concept ID registered twice.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL on duplicate registry keys.

rules.title: Invalid Registry Document
rules.description: Registry JSON fails its schema/shape contract.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if required registry fields missing.

rules.title: Immutable ID Violation In Registry
rules.description: Registry attempts to change meaning of existing KR-*/ENT-* id.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL on identity remap of published IDs.
rules.recommended_resolution: Preserve IDs; deprecate instead of remap.

rules.title: Registry Completeness Gap
rules.description: Manifest lists record not present in record_index/canonical_index.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if canon_manifest.records ⊄ indexes (except explicitly deferred).

rules.title: Concept Registry Missing Entry
rules.description: Concept KR missing from concept/canonical registry views.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if Concept type absent from canonical_index.

rules.title: Entity Registry Missing Entry
rules.description: Entity catalog KR missing from entity registry view.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if Entity type not indexed when required.

rules.title: Broken Cross Reference
rules.description: Cross-reference target does not resolve.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if xref target missing and not planned.

rules.title: Missing Cross Reference
rules.description: Required see-also / foundation xref absent vs pack design.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if pack design lists xref not present in cross_reference_index.

rules.title: Invalid Cross Reference
rules.description: Xref relation type invalid.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if relation not in allowed relation enum.
rules.recommended_resolution: Use ontology edge types or SEE_ALSO.

rules.title: Unknown Record Reference
rules.description: Reference to unknown KR-* outside manifests.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if KR-* not in canon_manifest/record_index and not planned.

rules.title: Canonical Key Collision
rules.description: Two record_ids share one canonical_key.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL uniqueness on canonical_index.canonical_key.
rules.recommended_resolution: Disambiguate keys; one concept one key.

rules.title: Alias Maps To Multiple Records
rules.description: Same normalized alias points to different KR-*.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL alias uniqueness.

rules.title: Pack Registry Orphan Module
rules.description: pack.module_id not in module_registry.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL pack→module FK.

rules.title: Manifest Discovery Path Broken
rules.description: canon_manifest.discovery.* path missing on disk.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if discovery target file absent.

rules.title: Bibliography Source Missing
rules.description: SRC-* cited but absent from bibliography.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL SRC FK check.
rules.recommended_resolution: Add source to bibliography or remove citation.

rules.title: Record Path Missing For Authored Status
rules.description: status=draft/review/official but path empty.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if authored status and path blank.
rules.recommended_resolution: Set filesystem path or set status=planned.

rules.title: Index Record Pack Mismatch
rules.description: record_index.pack_id ≠ pack_registry membership.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL cross-registry membership check.

rules.title: Concept Registry Incomplete For Pack Release
rules.description: Pack release candidate missing concept registry coverage.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if releasing pack with unindexed concepts.

rules.title: Entity Registry Incomplete For Pack Release
rules.description: Entity-type records in pack not present in entity registry view.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL entity coverage on pack release.
rules.recommended_resolution: Register all entity catalogs in pack.
